Lane litertlm-convert aa_mobile_b2_work/qwen35_9b: the published file is round r3d's metadata-only re-pack of 2026-10-16 (T1 = the Qwen3.5-4B Hub files' LlmMetadata section byte for byte: the 4B chat template with a thinking switch that defaults to off, the thought channel <think>\n / \n</think>, supports_thinking true; repack_T1/), whose TFLite, tokenizer and ExecutorMetadata sections are raw-identical to the file before it (repack_T1/work/Qwen3.5-9B_int8/section_compare.txt: ExecutorMetadata, tokenizer and TFLite raw ==, LlmMetadata 729 -> 4,314 B). These rows are the r3d gates of the published bytes on the Mac Studio (the Hub card's Correctness section): the 8-question gate on the CPU and the GPU, the three-turn conversation with thinking off, and the three-turn conversation with thinking on and thinking_token_budget 300 (the round's acceptance bar for thinking on, supervisor ruling 2026-10-16 17:4x). Without a budget the same three-turn conversation passed on the GPU and failed on the CPU at 2,048 tokens per turn (a thought ran to the cap without closing), and at 1,024 per turn the Mixed INT4 file left turns empty on both backends (gate_T1/*_multiturn_*_on.json, *_on_cap2048.json); greedy CPU runs differ between processes (two runs of one thinking-on prompt part after 101 characters), so CPU thinking results are counted over processes. No benchmark row: the lane's Mac benchmark (bench/parse.txt = SPEED_LADDER.md rows 1-4 = the Hub card's Performance table; litert-lm 0.18.0 CLI benchmark, 1024 / 256, context 2048, --cache no, two passes, the median: GPU 593.055 / 38.365 tok/s, TTFT 1.7542 s, printed init 96.0358 s, t 8.4268 s; CPU 228.09 / 15.055 tok/s, TTFT 4.5563 s, printed init 96.0827 s, t 21.4939 s) ran on the pre-T1 file (sha256 0af0f158..., ship_noswitch_20261016/, never shipped) - numbers in notes, not rows (#214 owner answer (a), #174(3)); the benchmark reads no template. The printed init of the 0.18.0 CLI sums overlapping init phases (about twice the engine build in the log's timestamps: the Mixed INT4 GPU run printed 89.19 s for a 44.53 s build, card_probes/init/int4_gpu_verbose.log). Precision: the file declares fp32 GPU activations; the int8 weights with the runtime's fp16 default answered 0 of 8 8-question items (every reply a run of '!', gate/int8_fp16act_gpu.json) while taking 7.5547 s against 8.19 s on the same workload. Engine reuse: on a shared Engine the second conversation broke in some runs (gate_T1/engine_share/; LiteRT-LM #3165) - one Engine per conversation. Phones: no record. The lane's home Galaxy S26 hold of 2026-10-15 22:48 found the phone off adb at its start (device/r1/s26/driver.log; no push, no engine: the phone had dropped in the previous lane's hold); the Hub card says the Mixed INT4 GPU engine does not build on a phone of that memory class; the int8 file is not started on that phone's GPU by the lane's rule after a sibling 8B-class int8 file restarted it during its GPU warm-up (2026-10-14); CPU legs not run (batch 1's CPU peak factors put both files above the phone's RAM). Pixel 8a not tried (no Qwen3.5 Hub file built a GPU engine on it under the memory guard, #206; the CPU factors put both files above its RAM).
